notes.title: Development Plan for Cyber Mokugyo
notes.notes:
Exciting Updates on Our Game Development Journey!

Hello, gamers and supporters!

We’re thrilled to share some exciting news about the future of our game. As part of our ongoing development plan, we are committed to continuously updating and enhancing the game experience. The version you see now is just the beginning of an incredible journey, and we have a lot in store for you!

Early-Stage Project and Upcoming Features
Our team is hard at work, and we are planning to roll out several supporting websites to enrich your experience as the game progresses. Here’s a sneak peek at what you can expect:

Blockchain Integration:
We are planning to deploy game assets on the Solana blockchain before the official game launch. To build hype and excitement, we will offer these assets through pre-sales on our social media channels and community groups. This initiative will help us generate enthusiasm and allow you to be part of our journey from the very start!
Inventory Service Launch:
Once the game is released, our top priority will be the launch of the inventory service. Players will have access to a Steam inventory system, both in-game and out of it. These inventories will be the foundation of our NFT project, allowing you to freely trade assets on the Steam marketplace.
Web 3.0 Development:
In the following phases, we will focus on creating cutting-edge Web 3.0 front-end applications. This will include a dedicated on-chain trading platform for Cyber Mokugyo, enabling seamless interaction between player inventories and on-chain assets. Additionally, we will offer limited edition NFTs for sale on this platform, which can only be purchased using our exclusive tokens.
Building a Complete Ecosystem:
Our ultimate goal is to create a rich ecosystem within the game. We plan to enhance gameplay, introduce management mechanics, and continue providing regular updates to keep the experience fresh and exciting for all players.
Join Us on This Journey!
We are grateful for your support and enthusiasm as we embark on this journey together. Your feedback and engagement are invaluable to us, and we can’t wait to share more updates with you in the coming weeks and months. Stay tuned for more announcements, and let’s make this an unforgettable adventure together!

Thank you for being part of our community!

Happy gaming!
